title: Connections
intro: Give outside tools a key to your calendar, tasks, contacts and mail. Store the passwords those tools need. Only you can see them.
keys_body: A key lets one tool, such as n8n, use the scopes you choose. The full key is shown once, when you create it. Revoke a key to stop it at once.
new_key_body: It will not be shown again. Put it in the tool as a Bearer token.
secrets_body: Passwords and tokens for other services. Each one is encrypted with a key made for your account. A value shows only after you type your password again.
drafts_body: A tool asked to send these messages. Nothing is sent until you approve it here.
failed: That did not work. Check the fields and try again.
